pythonFunction.name: validate_portal_pin
pythonFunction.description:
Checks the customer's portal PIN against the account (only when get_auth_options returned
pin_set true). The digits are never repeated back or logged. Before calling this tool, speak a
brief conversational pacing phrase while it runs.

Args:
    account_id: Account id of the identified account (REQUIRED).
    pin_dtmf: The PIN digits, spoken, keyed or typed (REQUIRED).
    tenant: Injected by the system from tenant_id; leave empty.

Returns:
    dict with ok, result (Pass or Fail), attempts_remaining and agent_action; on Pass
    auth_status becomes Authenticated.
